Data Science Intern

Atlanta, GA, US

About the role

Example Corp's Data Science Intern spends the summer with the forecasting team, improving the demand models that plan inventory across our stores. You will clean and join data from several systems, prototype models in Python, and present the results to planners.

What you will learn

  • How a production forecasting pipeline is built and monitored.
  • Feature engineering for time series with seasonality and promotions.
  • How to explain a model to the people who act on it.

Requirements

  • Enrolled in a bachelor's or master's program, graduating in 2027 or 2028.
  • Python with pandas and scikit-learn; SQL.
  • Eligible to work in the United States.
